Sure — two changes: cache the parsed file and validate once. Docs: fs module.

typescript
let cache: Config | undefined;
export function loadConfig(path = "config.json"): Config {
  cache ??= JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8"));
  return cache!;
}
